question: Approve the pi-agent-spacedock-state ideation design — Pi FO classified by boot envelope in transcript (no agentSetting), three-line toolResult branch in tool_result_text, session_workflows reuses the harness-agnostic parser — to proceed to implementation?

artifacts.summary: Pi collector classifies a first officer by finding a boot envelope in its transcript (Pi has no agentSetting); tool_result_text gains a toolResult branch so transcript_boot works on Pi; session_workflows is called to produce the same spacedock field a Claude FO publishes. Riskiest mechanism spiked against two live Pi FO transcripts (empty before the fix, correct after). Two falsifiable ACs + mock at pi-agent-spacedock-state/mock.html.
